core_categories: Healthcare Training Products; Medical Simulation Tools; Safety Equipment; CPR Training Products; Medical Devices
specialty_focus: WorldPoint is a global distributor of healthcare and CPR training products, medical simulation tools, and safety equipment. It serves hospitals, first responders, and educators, and is an authorized distributor of the American Heart Association. The company specializes in life-saving medical education supplies, including manikins, airway management tools, and trauma response kits, and does deal in wearable medical devices.
